floorNotes.weapon: inheritable weapons top out at 300 SP
floorNotes.assist: support assists such as Reposition stay available
floorNotes.passiveb: tier-4 B skills (400 SP lines included)

rules.maxTier: only the terminal node of an upgrade line is recommended
rules.spFloor: per-slot SP floor removes legacy lines with no successor
rules.scoring: max-condition stat + damage output; visible field buffs are taken once (highest source), in-combat stats and true damage accumulate

scoring.assumption: all conditions active (movement, HP, nearby allies, foe penalties)
